_about: Pinned, locally-vendored libraries for the slides skill. Populate the actual files with: python3 scripts/libfetch.py --all  (run once, in an environment with network). 'integrity' is the Subresource-Integrity hash (sha384). If null, libfetch records it on first fetch (trust-on-first-use) and prints it for you to review/commit; on later runs it is verified. You can also paste the official SRI published by jsdelivr/cdnjs to pin BEFORE the first download.

chartjs.use_when: Multi-axis, mixed-type, time-series, or densely interactive charts beyond slidegen's inline SVG.
chartjs.offline_notes: Single UMD JS file, exposes global `Chart`. Inlines cleanly. Set options.animation=false under data-static.

mermaid.use_when: Flowcharts, sequence, class, state, gantt, or ER diagrams declared as text. Don't hand-draw these.
mermaid.offline_notes: Large UMD file. Renders SVG at runtime; with data-static call mermaid.run() synchronously and wait for SVG before capture.

katex.use_when: LaTeX math typesetting (inline or display equations).
katex.offline_notes: katex.min.css references woff2/woff/ttf fonts via @font-face; libfetch parses and downloads them into fonts/. For single-file export, bundle.py base64-embeds those fonts into the CSS.

three.use_when: True 3D / parametric geometry / product or spatial visuals.
three.offline_notes: ES module (post-r150 dropped UMD). Load via an import map pointing at the local file, or lazy-import inside loadLib('three'). Heavy — prefer per-slide lazy load. Render one fixed frame at a pinned camera under data-static.

gsap.use_when: Choreographed multi-element timelines beyond what CSS keyframes can express cleanly. Otherwise prefer CSS.
gsap.offline_notes: UMD global `gsap`. Under data-static, set timelines to their end with tl.progress(1) (or .seek(tl.duration())) so capture is the finished state.

highlight.use_when: Real multi-language syntax highlighting when the hand-spanned .k/.fn/.s approach is too tedious or the snippet is long.
highlight.offline_notes: UMD global `hljs`. The theme CSS uses hard colors; override with :root vars in references/code-media.md so it matches the deck. No runtime animation — fully deterministic.

lazy._about: Heavier or rarely-needed libraries. Not committed by default; fetch on demand with: python3 scripts/libfetch.py d3 echarts

d3.use_when: Bespoke data-driven visuals Chart.js can't express (force graphs, custom layouts, geo).
d3.offline_notes: UMD global `d3`. You write the rendering; make any randomness use the deck's seeded RNG and freeze transitions under data-static.

echarts.use_when: Very rich interactive charts (heatmaps, candlesticks, large datasets).
echarts.offline_notes: UMD global `echarts`. Set animation:false in option under data-static.
